correctness.rationale: Complete prefix coding gives Kraft equality; finite decoder cycles consume an integral number of full de Bruijn periods; each such cycle has at least \(q^n/L\) steps, and its distinct starts have disjoint length-\(n\) source prefixes. Strong separation yields \(\eta_n\ge\delta r^{n-1}\), hence the exact quantitative lower bound \((\delta/r)^s/L\). The example is verified by exact disjoint rectangles; finite diagnostics are supplementary, and source Theorem 1.3 applies after checking its hypotheses.
